items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Before Harold's time. See, Harold came along with Bill George.

ctx.x: You didn't know the Franklin? She was a very famous woman until she went down. Oh, yeah. Now, you didn't know her. Well, she played piano with him. Now she was a George. And what's this other girl who used to play piano with him at times? That's before Harold's time. Before Harold's time. See, Harold came along with Bill George. Bill George. Yeah, Bill George and Allison. Bill George and Allison. Yeah. And that was in George's time. Yeah.

It was, well, everything was fine then because whenever they would, you know, play jobs and whatnot, they'd always stop in front of the house, you know. I can remember thinking we'd all run out as children, you know. And they'd have this, they would play in wagons and trucks and things and whatnot, you know. Old furniture wagons. Old furniture wagons and whatnot, you know. And then they would have them pass our house. And frankly, between Louise and Eve and Darrell Shays, and they'd stop and play us a number, you…
